bio.text: Vern Buchanan has represented Florida's 16th Congressional District in the U.S. House since 2007 and is Vice Chair of the Ways and Means Committee.
He grew up near Detroit, Michigan, served six years in the Air National Guard, and worked his way through college.

According to his office, he is a self-made businessman who previously chaired the Florida chapter of the Young Presidents' Organization, the Florida Chamber of Commerce and the Sarasota Chamber of Commerce; he lives in Longboat Key.
